sql: SELECT p.market_ticker, p.period_reward_usd usd, p.target_size, p.discount_factor_bps dbps, p.start_date, p.end_date, s.at, s.yes_levels_json, s.no_levels_json FROM incentive_programs p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT at, yes_levels_json, no_levels_json FROM incentive_market_snapshots x WHERE x.market_ticker=p.market_ticker AND x.at > now()-interval '1 day' ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE p.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.disappeared_at IS NULL AND p.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND status='resting')
